answer: Ephemeral Challenge Lattice. Each agent identity must solve a fresh, randomly generated challenge whose answer is derived from live system state, so the same answer never admits twice. Responses are checked against a rotating jade-seeded hash, and every submission expires within one pulse of the network clock, forcing continuous re-registration. An attacker cloning identities must recompute and submit fresh solutions for each one, paying full compute and latency per identity per horizon, with no replay reuse across epochs.
